sources.title: Türkiye: Draft Law Threatens LGBT People with Prison | Human Rights Watch
sources.claim_summary: Human Rights Watch (29 Oct 2025): the leaked omnibus '11th Judicial Package' would amend penal-code article 225 so that acts 'contrary to biological sex and general morality' carry up to 3 years and same-sex engagement or marriage ceremonies up to 4 years; amend civil-code article 40 ('Changing Sex') to raise the gender-affirming care minimum age from 18 to 25 with mandatory infertility and government-approved hospital evaluation; and imprison care providers up to 7 years and trans patients up to 3 years. National-level document; no province-specific content for this unit.

Kaos GL's LGBTI+ Human Rights Report 2025 (launched in Ankara, 24 Feb 2026): in 2025 anti-LGBTI+ hostility became explicit state policy — presidential and 'Year of the Family' institutional directives, religious-authority and broadcasting-regulator censorship, one LGBTI+ rights organisation closed; six violations of the right to life documented (three hate-motivated killings, trans people most affected), 89 torture/ill-treatment violations (51 the previous year), 313 liberty violations (about 2.5x the previous year, mostly detention procedure). National monitoring with no provincial breakdown.
